title: ControlRequest
description: Proposed action, actor, target, declared effects and data classifications (plan: 'Wire contracts'). Net-new wire form of the concept named ControlRequest in team.py; that in-process dataclass carries live GroundingContext/GovernanceBlock objects and is never itself serialised. Distinct identity from that type; do not conflate.

declared_effects.description: effects the actor declares the action will have; an undeclared effect observed later is a drift/confused-deputy signal, not admitted by this field alone

data_classifications.description: sensitivity labels of data the action touches (e.g. pii, secret, public)
